label: late-episode D1 after an unrewarded visit to S2
explanation: Fires only at D1, and only when the previous trial was unrewarded (in_rew = 0; never after reward). Never at GO or D2. It is strongly gated by episode time: essentially silent before trial 30 and rising steeply to trial 99 (53% of mass in trials 90-99). It needs low value (value < 7.13 holds 97% of mass). Within unrewarded late D1 steps it prefers ones where the unrewarded state was S2 (prev_state == 2, 2.3x for rare previous transitions), and it leans toward an upcoming a1 choice (82% of mass) and good = S1. The recorded predicate uses only observed variables (dev F1 0.57, mass recall 0.82). Adding the agent own upcoming choice (action == 1) raises dev F1 to 0.62 but lowers mass recall to 0.66, so I kept the simpler observed version. The base predicate D1 & unrewarded has recall 1.0 but precision 0.08, so the unit is a sparse, late-episode, no-reward-at-S2 / shift-toward-a1 detector. Magnitude grows with ep_trial and is highest for D1 at rel +1 and in windows with a common-unrewarded or rare-unrewarded core.
